facts.title: hazard report - chemical exposure at V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on V-4110 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on V-4110 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during routine operation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 18 August 2014 a hazard report was recorded on V-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
